ignoreValues.reason: Icon-button hover pairs (text-gray-400 + hover:text-X-400 + hover:bg-X-500/10): gray text and the colored bg are mutually exclusive states (bg only appears on hover, when text also switches off gray), but the static Tailwind-class regex can't see the pseudo-class pairing. Pre-existing pattern reused throughout this file (edit/delete icon buttons).

Colored left-accent border on rounded stat cards (border-l-2 + rounded-lg) is an established, repo-wide design convention (also in SessionDetail, AgentCard, Dashboard, SessionCard, MarkdownContent), not an accidental AI-slop tell. Pre-existing code (Son Nguyen, 2026-03-10), predates all session branches. Scoped to this file only, not a repo-wide rule ignore.

splash-hook-gate-realtime is a static info callout (icon + one sentence explaining real-time hook behavior), matching the side-tab rule's own documented exemption for toast/snackbar/callout accents. The rule's exemption only fires for role=status|alert|log or aria-live elements; this static div has neither, so the detector misses it. Consistent with the file's info(blue-left-accent)/warning(full-border) color-coding convention.
